FN-DGCUYNH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 401
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Kelvin Datcher
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/10/2026
House Bill 401 as introduced would, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027: (1) increase the mortgage
record tax from $0.15 for each $100 of indebtedness, under current law, to $0.30 for each $100
of indebtedness; and (2) revise the distribution of mortgage record tax proceeds as shown below,
which would increase mortgage record tax collections by the following estimated amounts to the
following entities:
Fund/Entity Current Distribution New Distribution Amount
Alabama Housing Trust Fund - 25% $31,900,000
County Treasuries 33% 33% $21,900,000
State General Fund 67% 37% $6,800,000
Probate Judges - 5% $3,200,000
TOTAL 100% 100% $63,700,000
